# AudioSceneListener <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
AudioSceneListener:Void scene:Int32, setting:Int32, value:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene` | In | Int32 | required | A scene from [CreateAudioScene](CreateAudioScene). Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `setting` | In | Int32 | required | `BB_LISTENER_ROLLOFF` (1, [ListenerRolloff](ListenerRolloff)), `BB_LISTENER_DOPPLER` (2, [ListenerDoppler](ListenerDoppler)), `BB_LISTENER_DISTANCE` (3, [ListenerDistance](ListenerDistance)), `BB_LISTENER_SPEEDOFSOUND` (4, [SpeedOfSound](SpeedOfSound)) or `BB_LISTENER_RADIUS` (5, [ListenerRadius](ListenerRadius)), from the shipped include file audio.bb. Anything else is a runtime error. |
| `value` | In | Float32 | required | The value, with the same limits as the command of the setting. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets a listener setting that the scene sets when it is applied. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Include "<audio.bb>"
AudioSceneListener underwater, BB_LISTENER_SPEEDOFSOUND, 1480
```
